answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the opal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
